entries.name: Feast of the Black Christ of Esquipulas
entries.capsule: Feast of Guatemala's most venerated crucifix; Worthington parishioners celebrate with Mass, marimba, dance and a procession.
entries.dateRule: January 15 each year; Minnesota parish celebrations may be held on a nearby Sunday.
entries.whatItMarks: Veneration of a late 16th-century crucifix at the basilica in Esquipulas, Guatemala, darkened by centuries of candle smoke; it is a source of communal identity across Central America.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: At St. Mary's Catholic Church in Worthington, families from San Marcos held what AP called their biggest celebration yet on Sunday, Jan. 12, 2025: a Mass with a barefoot offering dance in traje, a procession with a replica statue commissioned in Esquipulas, two marimbas brought from Guatemala, a free taco lunch in the parish school cafeteria and an hours-long prayer service. The community raised nearly $40,000 for the statue and marimbas. No 2026 or later date was found.

minnesotaEvents.name: Black Christ of Esquipulas feast celebration
minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: Held Sunday, Jan. 12, 2025 (preparations Jan. 11); no 2026 date found
